A QUICK FIELD GUIDE

Golem Village Watch

  1. Move with the left stick or WASD. Tap PUNCH or Space to strike the nearest zombie in range.
  2. Red ground cues warn of an attack. Tap DODGE to slip away and avoid damage.
  3. Protect the village through 3 waves. Watch both your hearts and the village gate.
